reason: The plugin primarily processes SillyTavern character-card files, splitting their contents into structured workspace data and creating a corresponding local workspace for roleplay use.

summaries.zh: 用于导入 SillyTavern PNG、JSON 和 Lorebook 角色卡，拆分其中的世界书、正则与脚本并创建对应的本地工作区。
summaries.en: Imports SillyTavern PNG, JSON, and Lorebook character cards, separates their worldbooks, regexes, and scripts, and creates a corresponding local workspace.

capabilities: Reads user-selected PNG, JSON, and Lorebook files
Writes imported card data into local workspace files
Creates and registers a same-name workspace
Provides a UI file picker and drag-and-drop import flow
